blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Retrieving information from visually rich documents requires matching queries against pages that contain complex evidence in tables, figures, and layout-dependent structures. Current vision-language retrievers address this but incur query-time costs that grow with corpus size and are impractical to scale. We propose SCOUT, a cascaded two-track retrieval framework that separates retrieval performance from exhaustive search. The visual track first uses a lightweight parent retriever to filter the corpus to a compact candidate pool, then applies a stronger multi-vector reranker only to those candidates. In parallel, a semantic track retrieves over hierarchical page and document summaries generated offline to provide a signal complementary to visual matching. The outputs are fused through cross-modal query refinement, which uses semantic scores to adjust the visual query representation before final ranking. We evaluate SCOUT on 4 major benchmarks against 6 baselines and observe a significant query-time latency improvement up to 80.7x (28.8x on average) relative to the best baseline, while exceeding state-of-the-art retrieval performance by up to 7.8% NDCG across all benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 从视觉丰富的文档中获取信息,需要将查询与表格、数字和布局依赖结构中包含复杂证据的页面相匹配。 目前的视觉语言检索器处理这个问题,但产生查询时间成本,随着体积增加,不切实际。 我们提议SCOUT,一个级联双轨检索框架,将检索的性能与详尽无遗的检索区分开来. 视觉赛道首先使用轻量级的家长寻回器将保单过滤到紧凑的候选球池中,然后只对这些候选球员使用更强的多成绩复排. 同时,一个语义轨道在分级页面上进行检索,并生成离线文件摘要,以提供辅助视觉匹配的信号. 输出通过跨模式查询的精细化实现融合,在最终排名前使用语义分数来调整视觉查询表现. 我们对照6个基准,对SCOUT的4个主要基准进行评估,并观察到与最佳基准相比,查询时间延迟性显著改善,达到80.7x(平均28.8x),同时在所有基准中,检索性能超过最新水平,达到7.8%。

blocks.en:
Document retrieval is a well-studied problem Abootorabi et al. (2025) ; Tanaka et al. (2025) , yet retrieving visually rich documents remains challenging in open-domain settings that require searching across an entire corpus rather than a predefined collection.
As illustrated in Figure 1 , a query may require evidence distributed across multiple pages of a large report collection. This evidence often appears in tables, figures, or layout-dependent passages, while many pages in the corpus may share similar visual structures. Consequently, even a strong visual retriever that scores every page can fail to place all relevant pages within a practical retrieval window.
This setting highlights two requirements for a practical retriever: (a) matching fine-grained evidence within each page, and (b) doing so at a query-time cost that remains affordable as the corpus grows.

blocks.en:
This challenge is relevant to enterprise collections that contain complex information in tables, figures, and layout-dependent structures that text extraction does not preserve completely Huang et al. (2022) ; Cho et al. (2025) . Consequently, text-based retrieval can operate on incomplete representations. Our experiments show that retrieving over extracted page text rather than page images reduces NDCG@10 by up to 13.5 13.5 points when using the same embedding backbone (Table 2 ). Recent vision-language retrievers address this limitation by embedding document pages directly as images and have achieved strong performance on visual document retrieval benchmarks Faysse et al. (2025) ; Yu et al. (2025) ; Nomic Team (2025) .
However, their high query-time latency remains a practical bottleneck for real-world use cases.
In typical enterprise settings, documents are indexed infrequently, while retrieval may occur several times per user request Wang et al. (2025) .
Retrieval costs therefore accumulate continuously, raising the question of how such systems can scale.
Table 1 highlights three major gaps in the existing approaches:
(a) cost: multi-vector visual retrievers match every query against every page, so query cost grows with the corpus Lee et al. (2023) ; Santhanam et al. (2022) ; Bruch et al. (2024) , while lighter single-vector models are faster but lose fine-grained accuracy Nussbaum et al. (2025) ;
(b) recall: cascades cut cost by filtering before reranking, but a page missed by the filter cannot be recovered later Qu et al. (2021) , which is most likely when many pages look alike; and
(c) fusion: textual evidence complements visual matching, but rank-level fusion discards how that evidence relates to the query, and query-level refinement Uzan et al. (2026) still applies multi-vector scoring to the full corpus.

Our observation is that these gaps can be closed together because the signals are complementary and exhaustive token-level matching is needed only to separate a few visually similar candidates. We therefore propose SCOUT 1 1 1 SCOUT : S caled C ascade with cr O ss-modal q U ery refinemen T , a cascaded two-track multimodal retrieval framework. Track A is a visual cascade: a lightweight single-vector retriever filters the corpus to a small pool of K K pages, which a stronger multi-vector model then reranks with late interaction. Track B retrieves over hierarchical document- and page-level summaries generated once offline, so pages missed by Track A can still enter the pool. The two tracks are combined through cross-modal query refinement (CMQR) Uzan et al. (2026) , which uses the semantic scores to adjust the visual query representation at test time before the final ranking.
The costly late-interaction and refinement phases are independent of corpus size and work on a fixed candidate pool.
We evaluate SCOUT on four benchmarks, ViDoRe (eight domain-specific subsets), ViDoSeek, SlideVQA, and REAL-MM-RAG (four domain-specific subsets), against six baseline methods. SCOUT matches or exceeds the strongest exhaustive retriever in retrieval quality (+3.1% average NDCG@10) while improving query latency by 28.8 × \times on average (up to 80.7 × \times ). These gains carry over to downstream answer generation and hold under query rephrasing.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Visual document retrieval (VDR) aims to retrieve relevant pages from visually rich documents containing dense layouts, figures, tables, and charts.
Traditional pipelines rely on OCR or extracted text followed by lexical or dense retrieval ( Karpukhin et al., 2020 ; Tanaka et al., 2021 ) ; recent dense models such as Linq-Embed, Qwen3-Embedding, and Jina-Text provide strong OCR- or summary-based text baselines ( Choi et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ; Günther et al., 2025 ) .
However, text-only retrieval can miss evidence encoded in layout and visual structure Huang et al. (2022) .
Native visual and multimodal retrievers such as Jina Vision and ColNomic-7B embed page images directly, while late-interaction models such as ColEmbed-3B-v2 use MaxSim-style token- or patch-level scoring ( Günther et al., 2025 ; Nomic Team, 2025 ; de Souza P. Moreira et al., 2026 ) .
Our pipeline is built in this direction where we rerank a compact set of candidate pages and fuse the results with summary-based feedback, avoiding full-corpus multi-vector scoring.
blocks.zh:
视觉文件检索(VDR)旨在从含有密集布局、数字、表格和图表的视觉丰富的文件中检索相关页面。
传统的管道依赖OCR或提取的文本,然后是词汇或密集检索(Karpukhin等人,2020年;Tanaka等人,2021年);最近密集的模型,如Linq-Embed,Qune3-Embedding,和Jina-Text提供了强大的OCR或摘要文本基线(Choi等人,2024年;Zhang等人,2025年;Günther等人,2025年)。
然而,仅文本检索可能会错过在布局和视觉结构中编码的证据 黄等 (2022).
Jina Vision和ColNomic-7B等原生视觉和多模式检索器直接嵌入页面图像,而ColEmbed-3B-v2等后期交互模型则使用MaxSim风格的符号-或补丁级评分(Günther等人,2025年;Nomic Team,2025年;de Souza P. Moreira等人,2026年).
我们的管道就是朝这个方向建造的,我们重新排列一组紧凑的候选网页,并将结果与简要反馈结合起来,避免全军多战员评分。

blocks.en:
Hybrid retrieval combines complementary retrievers, such as lexical, dense-text, and visual models ( Dos Santos et al., 2015 ; Kuzi et al., 2020 ) .
Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) is a simple rank-level method for combining retrieval outputs ( Cormack et al., 2009 ) , but it does not use the geometry of the embedding spaces.
Test-time query refinement instead updates the query representation using retrieved evidence, building on pseudo-relevance feedback in dense retrieval ( Yu et al., 2021 ; Sung et al., 2023 ) .
Guided Query Refinement (GQR) refines visual query embedding using feedback from a complementary text retriever Uzan et al. (2026) .
We apply this idea in a cascaded setting, where a lightweight first stage forms the candidate pool before ColEmbed-style reranking and Qwen3-guided refinement.
blocks.zh:
混合检索结合了互补的检索器,如词典,稠密文本,和视觉模型(Dos Santos等人,2015年;Kuzi等人,2020年).
对等的Rank Fusion(RRF)是一种简单的分级方法,用于合并检索输出(Cormack et al.,2009),但它并不使用嵌入空间的几何.
测试时间查询的改进,而是利用检索到的证据,在密集检索中的伪相关反馈的基础上,更新查询表述(Yu等人,2021年;Sung等人,2023年)。
Guided Query Refinement(GQR)利用来自互补文本检索器Uzan等人(2026年)的反馈,完善了视觉查询嵌入.
我们把这个想法应用在一个阶梯式的环境下,在ColEmbed式的重新排位和Qune3制导的改进之前,一个轻量级的第一阶段构成候选人才池.

blocks.en:
Cascaded retrieval balances efficiency and accuracy by using a fast first-stage retriever followed by a stronger reranker ( Wang et al., 2011 ; Nogueira and Cho, 2019 ) .
This is especially important for multi-vector retrieval, where late-interaction scoring over the full corpus is expensive.
Prior work such as PLAID and EMVB improves efficiency within multi-vector indexes through pruning, clustering, or quantization ( Santhanam et al., 2022 ; Nardini et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh:
通过使用快速的第一阶段检索器,继而使用更强的重新排名器(Wang等人,2011年;Nogueira和Cho,2019年),Cascadd检索平衡了效率和准确性。
这对于多媒介检索尤为重要,因为在该数据库中,晚交对全体的评分费用高昂。
以往的工作,如PLAID和EMVB,通过挤压、组装或量化,提高了多媒介指数的效率(Santhanam等人,2022年;Nardini等人,2024年)。

blocks.en: In summary, prior work addresses efficiency, recall, or multimodal evidence in isolation (c.f. Table 1 ). Multi-vector indexes speed up scoring within a single modality, cascades are limited by first-stage recall, and hybrid fusion adds textual evidence but still scores the full corpus. SCOUT brings novelty by cascading this pipeline for optimized retrieval. Cheap visual filtering and offline textual summaries select a small pool of K K pages, so costly late interaction and query refinement run only on that pool and their cost is independent of corpus size, while the textual evidence both recovers missed pages and shapes the final ranking.
blocks.zh: 总而言之,以前的工作涉及效率、召回或多式联运证据(见表1)。 多变量指数在一个单一模式内加快评分速度,级联受到第一阶段召回的限制,混合聚变增加了文字证据,但仍然对全数进行评分. SCOUT为优化检索而将这条管道串联起来,带来了新颖之处。 廉价的视觉过滤和离线文本摘要选择了一小堆K页,如此昂贵的晚期互动和查询完善只运行在该池上,其成本独立于实体大小,而文本证据既恢复了错失的页面,也塑造了最终排名.

Left (offline phase): each page in the corpus is dual-encoded as (a) a concatenated doc-level + page-level summary embedding and (b) a single visual embedding. blocks.en:
SCOUT is a cascaded framework for visual document retrieval.
To decouple the cost of corpus processing from query-time computation, we segregate the framework into two phases, online and offline.
In the offline phase, we construct a compressed representation of the corpus by generating hierarchical textual summaries for each document and page, as described next. In the online phase, a query is processed through two parallel tracks: (a) Track A is a cascaded visual track that operates on rendered page images (Section 3.1.1 ), and (b) Track B is a semantic track that operates on the pre-computed summaries (Section 3.1.2 ). The outputs of both tracks are jointly refined to produce the final ranked list.

SCOUT是一个用于视觉文档检索的级联框架.
为了从查询时间的计算中去掉手续费,我们把框架分成两个阶段,即在线和离线。

blocks.en: 3.1.3 Cross-Modal Query Refinement.
blocks.zh: 3.1.3 跨莫达尔查询改进。

blocks.en:
SCOUT ’s two parallel tracks yield complementary rankings: the visual track captures layout, figures, and spatial structure; the semantic track captures textual and numerical content surfaced through the summaries. Traditionally, combining these at the rank level discards information about how semantic scores relate to individual visual query token representations.
Hence, we apply a novel representation-level fusion using Cross Modal Query Refinement (CMQR) adapted from Guided Query Refinement Uzan et al. (2026) , which uses the semantic track’s scores to refine the visual query embedding before final scoring.

blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: In this section, we summarize benchmark, baseline, and metric selection.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们概述了基准、基线和衡量标准选择。

blocks.en: We evaluate on ViDoRe v3 Loison et al. (2026) , a domain-diverse visual document retrieval benchmark spanning multiple document types and application areas. To test robustness across different document collections, we additionally evaluate on ViDoSeek Wang et al. (2025) , refined SlideVQA Tanaka et al. (2023) , and REAL-MM-RAG Wasserman et al. (2025) . These datasets cover visually rich pages with tables, figures, charts, slides, and dense layouts, making them suitable for comparing text-only, visual, and multi-vector retrieval methods.

blocks.en: We evaluate efficiency using average query latency (ms/query), measured over online retrieval, reranking, fusion, and refinement after offline indexing. Retrieval quality is measured using NDCG@5 and NDCG@10.
blocks.zh: 我们使用平均查询间隔(ms/query)来评估效率,衡量在线检索、重新排位、聚变和离线索引的完善。 检索质量使用NDCG@5和NDCG@10测量.

blocks.en:
We compare against dense text, visual, and multi-vector retrieval baselines.
For text-only retrieval, we evaluate Linq-Embed-Mistral Choi et al. (2024) , Qwen3-Embedding Zhang et al. (2025) , and Jina-v4 text Günther et al. (2025) embeddings using OCR-derived text. For visual retrieval, we evaluate models that operate on page images, including Jina-v4 vision, ColNomic-7B Nomic Team (2025) and ColEmbed-3B-v2 Xu et al. (2025) . Table 16 in summarizes all methods.

blocks.en: 5.1 Performance Comparison
blocks.zh: 5.1 业绩比较

blocks.en: The performance of SCOUT across four benchmarks is summarized in Table 2 . SCOUT outperforms (or levels up) SOTA performance across all benchmarks while retrieving at a fraction of its query-time cost. SOTA (in our case, ColEmbed-3B-v2) suffers with latencies between 4.5 4.5 – 32.8 32.8 sec/query depending on corpus size. SCOUT limits late-interaction scoring to Top-K candidate pages, reducing latency to 387 387 - 553 553 milliseconds/query across all benchmarks. This is a gain of 8.4 × 8.4\times on ViDoRe-HR to 80.7 × 80.7\times on SlideVQA , with an average of 28.8 × 28.8\times across all benchmarks (c.f. Table 15 ). The Pareto boundary in Figure 3 (a) and the latency breakdown in Figure 3 (b) illustrate this efficiency advantage. Also, we report the per-dataset index footprint comparison in Table 8 .
blocks.zh: 表2汇总了SCOUT在四个基准方面的业绩。 SCOUT 超越(或升级)所有基准的 SOTA 性能,同时以查询时间成本的一小部分进行检索. SOTA(就我们而言,ColEmbed-3B-v2)的晚期病情在4.5 - 32.8 32.8秒/平方秒之间,取决于体积大小。 SCOUT将后期互动评分限制在Top-K候选页面,将所有基准的延迟度降至387 387-553毫秒/秒。 在ViDoRe-HR上,这一收益为8.4×8.4乘,在SlidVQA上为80.7×80.7乘,在所有基准上平均为28.8×28.8乘(见表15)。 图3(a)中的帕雷托边界和图3(b)中随机分解说明了这一效率优势。 我们还在表8中报告每个数据集的指数足迹比较。

blocks.en:
Overall, SCOUT demonstrates consistent improvement across all benchmarks.
On ViDoRe 3 , SCOUT achieves NDCG@5 of 58.85 58.85 and NDCG@10 of 61.31 61.31 , compared to 56.65 56.65 and 58.99 58.99 for SOTA, an average improvement of + 3.9 +3.9 % respectively. On ViDoSeek , NDCG@5 improves from 85.48 85.48 to 87.41 87.41 ( Δ = + 2.3 \Delta{=}+2.3 %) when compared with the best performer (Jina-vis). On SlideVQA , where the strongest baseline is already near saturation, the gain is modest, but SCOUT still provides a substantial latency reduction (see Table 2 ). To evaluate SCOUT ’s performance in downstream tasks, we report performance on the Vidore V3 benchmark in Table 14 (c.f. Appendix B.7 ).

blocks.en: We compare two fusion strategies over the same candidate union 𝒰 q \mathcal{U}_{q} : reciprocal rank fusion (RRF) and our CMQR (built on GQR). CMQR adds a modest refinement cost but improves the final ranking on every ViDoRe 3 subset and on all four benchmarks (Table 12 ; further results in Appendix D ). The gap grows as the two tracks’ top-10 rankings diverge (Figure 8 ): CMQR’s gain over ColEmbed rises from + 1.9 % +1.9\% to + 5.7 % +5.7\% , whereas RRF falls from − 1.2 % -1.2\% to − 8.9 % -8.9\% . The same pattern holds across subsets: CMQR’s gain over RRF is largest where the rankings diverge most (Finance-FR + 17.37 % +17.37\% , Industrial + 12.86 % +12.86\% , REAL FinReport + 14.49 % +14.49\% ; Spearman ρ = 0.79 \rho=0.79 between gain and divergence). We attribute this to when the two signals interact. RRF merges the rankings only after each track has ranked pages independently, so semantic evidence never influences visual matching. CMQR instead uses the semantic scores as soft supervision to refine the visual query token representations directly, so textual evidence guides visual matching before final scoring.

CMQR转而使用语义分数作为软监督,直接完善视觉查询符表示,因此文字证据在最终评分前指导视觉匹配.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
Exhaustive multi-vector search over large document corpora performs well, but is impractical at scale; SCOUT addresses this with a cascaded two parallel track framework that combines bounded late-interaction visual retrieval with offline hierarchical summarization and cross-modal query refinement. Across 4 benchmarks, SCOUT reduces query-time latency up to 80.7 × 80.7\times ( 28.8 × 28.8\times on average) while exceeding state-of-the-art accuracy by up to 7.8 % 7.8\% NDCG.
Our findings show that the child reranker lifts retrieval performance by 20.9 % 20.9\% over the parent retriever alone, and CMQR adds up to 7.78 7.78 NDCG@10 points over the visual cascade by refining the query representation using semantic scores.
We close with practical considerations showing that SCOUT is robust to component choice with interchangeable retrievers.
blocks.zh:
对大文档的多向量搜索表现良好,但规模不切实际;SCOUT通过两个级联并行的轨道框架解决这一问题,其中结合了捆绑的晚交式视觉检索与离线分级汇总和跨模式查询的改进。 在4个基准中,SCOUT将查询-时间间隔降低至80.7×80.7\时(平均28.8×28.8\时),同时超过最新精度,达到7.8%7.8%的NDCG.
我们的发现显示,孩子的重新排名将检索性能提升了20.9% 20.9 % ,而CMQR则通过使用语义分数来改进查询表现,在视觉级联上共提升了7.78 7.78 NDCG@10分.
我们最后提出一些实际考虑,表明SCOUT能够用可互换的检索器来组成选择。

blocks.en: 8 Limitations and Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 8 限制和道德考虑

blocks.en:
SCOUT can only rank pages that enter its candidate pool. Track B recovers many pages missed by the parent retriever, but pages ranked low by both tracks remain unrecoverable. The semantic track relies on offline summaries from a proprietary VLM (Gemini 2.5 Flash), which may omit or misrepresent page content. Additionally, the semantic track depends on offline VLM-generated summaries, which may occasionally omit or misrepresent page
content; higher-quality summarization models can be substituted as they become
available, given the modular design of SCOUT . Offline indexing is a one-time
cost excluded from query-time latency and amortizes over all queries, though it may need to be refreshed for frequently updated corpora (which is a lesser frequency practice in enterprise).
blocks.zh:
SCOUT只能对进入其候选人才库的页面进行排名. 音轨 B恢复了许多被母检索器错过的页面,但两个音轨排名较低的页面仍然无法恢复. 语义音轨依赖于来自专有VLM(Gemini 2.5 Flash)的离线摘要,这些摘要可能省略或误译页面内容. 此外,语义音轨依赖于离线的 VLM 生成的摘要,这些摘要偶尔可能会省略或错报页面
内容; 质量更高的归纳模型在成为时可以替换
,考虑到SCOUT的模块设计。 离线索引是一次性的
成本不包括在查询时间中,并对所有查询进行摊销,尽管可能需要对经常更新的公司(企业中频率较低的做法)加以刷新。

blocks.en: SCOUT is a retrieval framework that does not generate content or model artifacts. Visual document collections may contain sensitive enterprise, financial, legal, or personal information; practitioners should ensure appropriate access control, data retention policies, and privacy-preserving indexing when deploying SCOUT in such settings as per the organization policies. As with any retrieval system, retrieved pages should be treated as evidence candidates rather than guaranteed ground truth, and human oversight is encouraged in high-stakes decision-making contexts. Future work should explore privacy-preserving indexing strategies and end-to-end evaluation under realistic user-facing RAG workflows.
blocks.zh: SCOUT是一个不产生内容或模型文物的检索框架. 视觉文件收集可能包含敏感的企业、财务、法律或个人信息;从业者在按照组织政策部署SCOUT时,应确保适当的访问控制、数据保留政策和隐私保护索引。 与任何检索系统一样,检索的网页应作为证据候选人对待,而不是作为有保障的基本真相对待,并鼓励在高度决策背景下进行人的监督。 今后的工作应探索在现实的用户信息化RAG工作流程下制定保护隐私的索引战略和进行端到端评价。

blocks.en: B.2 Document Retrieval Models
blocks.zh: B.2 文件检索模式

blocks.en: Visual document retrieval methods fall into two families. Text-mediated retrieval first converts each page into a textual surrogate-via OCR, layout parsing, or VLM-generated descriptions-and then retrieves with a standard text encoder. This reuses mature text retrievers, but the conversion step discards spatial layout and visual content, and extraction errors propagate into the index. Image-native multi-vector retrieval removes the conversion step: a vision-language backbone encodes the page as patch-level token embeddings, the query is encoded as text tokens by the same model, and relevance is the late-interaction (MaxSim) sum introduced by ColBERT Khattab and Zaharia (2020) and brought to images by ColPali Faysse et al. (2025) . This preserves layout and requires no OCR at query time, and has since been instantiated on several backbones. Its weakness is cost: representing each page with hundreds to thousands of token vectors makes exhaustive search expensive at scale. Table 16 lists the retrievers we evaluate across both families.
blocks.zh: 视觉文件检索方法分为两个家族. 文本介质检索首先将每个页面转换为文本代理-通过OCR,布局解析,或VLM生成描述-然后用标准文本编码器检索. 这种再利用成熟的文本检索器,但转换步骤抛弃了空间布局和视觉内容,提取错误传播到索引中. 图像本土多向量检索移除了转换步骤:一个视觉语言主干线将页面编码为补丁级符号嵌入,查询由同一模型编码为文本符号,相关性是ColBERT Khattab和Zaharia(2020年)推出并由ColPali Faysse et al.(2025年)带给图像的后期交互(MaxSim)总和. 这保留了布局,在查询时不需要OCR,从此就被分解在几个骨干上. 它的弱点是成本:代表每一页的符号矢量有几百到几千个,因此在规模上详尽无遗的搜索费用昂贵. 表16列出了我们在两个家庭评估的检索者。

blocks.en: SCOUT generates hierarchical page and document summaries once per corpus, at indexing time. Table 10 reports this one-time cost for all evaluated corpora using Gemini 2.5 Flash. Summarization costs roughly $0.0023 and 300 ms of wall-clock time per page (with 12 parallel API workers). Indexing the full ViDoRe 3 corpus (19,256 pages) costs $44.81 and takes about 1h 40m, and all four corpora (41,245 pages) together cost under $100. The cost is incurred offline and never affects query-time latency, which makes it practical for enterprise settings where corpora are static or slowly updated. For frequently updated corpora, only newly added pages need to be summarized, so the update cost scales with the number of changed pages rather than with corpus size.

blocks.en: Appendix C Practical Considerations
blocks.zh: 附录C 考虑因素

blocks.en: SCOUT is designed to be modular and deployment-friendly. The parent retriever is interchangeable depending on enterprise requirements. Table 9 shows how performance varies with different retrievers, at the cost of a 27 × \times larger storage ( 0.23 0.23 GB vs. 6.35 6.35 GB). For storage-constrained deployments, a smaller model (e.g. Nemotron-Embed-VL-1B) is a practical choice, however even replacing it with larger models (e.g. ColNomic-7B), the performance sees only a bare minimum gain. Likewise, the child reranker can be replaced by any enterprise-specific reranker, with the only constraint that it produces embeddings to support the downstream similarity function in CMQR. This storage-latency trade-off gives a clear axis for tuning SCOUT with deployment constraints.
blocks.zh: SCOUT设计为模块化和部署友好型. 母检索器可根据企业要求互换。 表9显示不同检索器的性能如何不同,成本为27×x\times较大存储(0.23 0.23 GB对6.35 6.35 GB). 对于存储受约束的部署,一个较小的模型(如Nemotron-Embed-VL-1B)是一个实际选择,然而,甚至用更大的模型(如ColNomic-7B)来取代它,性能只看到一个最小的利润. 同样,孩子的重排可以被任何企业特有的重排器所取代,唯一的限制是它会产生嵌入物以支持CMQR中的下游相似性功能. 这种存储相关性的权衡,为在部署限制下调整SCOUT提供了明确的轴线.

blocks.en:
Across both query types, the child reranker consistently improves over parent retrieval, confirming the value of bounded late-interaction reranking.
On ViDoRe single-hop queries, NDCG@10 increases from 49.37 49.37 to 58.05 58.05 after reranking ( Δ = + 8.68 \Delta{=}+8.68 ), and the full pipeline further improves to 62.41 62.41 ( Δ = + 4.36 \Delta{=}+4.36 over the reranker). The same trend holds on ViDoRe multi-hop queries, where performance rises from 39.69 39.69 to 46.03 46.03 and then to 49.67 49.67 .
SlideVQA shows a similar pattern, with the full pipeline achieving the best score on both single-hop and multi-hop subsets.
On ViDoSeek, SCOUT improves strongly over parent retrieval on both splits, although on the multi-hop subset the full pipeline is effectively tied with the child reranker ( 91.17 91.17 vs. 91.22 91.22 ).
blocks.zh:
在所有两种查询类型中,孩子的重新排名比父母的检索持续改善,证实了限定的后期互动重新排名的价值。
在ViDore单跳查询上,NDCG@10在重新排位后,从49.37 49.37升至58.05 58.05 (+ + 8.68 + Delta{=}+ 8.68),全管道进一步提升至62.41 62.41 (+ = + 4.36 + Delta{=}+ 4.36) 重排. ViDore多跳查询也呈现同样的趋势,其性能从39.69 39.69升至46.03 46.03,然后升至49.67 49.67.
SlidVQA显示了类似的模式,整个管道在单跳和多跳子集上都取得了最佳分数.
在ViDoSeek上,SCOUT在两个拆分上大大改进了父母的检索,虽然在多跳子集上,整个管道实际上与孩子的重新排名器相连(91.17 91.17 vs 91.22 91.22 )。

blocks.en:
Multi-hop queries are harder on ViDoRe and SlideVQA, where full-pipeline NDCG@10 drops from 62.41 62.41 to 49.67 49.67 and from 95.59 95.59 to 93.37 93.37 , respectively.
ViDoSeek is an exception: its multi-hop subset scores higher than its single-hop subset across all stages, suggesting that query difficulty is dataset-dependent rather than determined only by hop count.
Overall, the cascade remains effective across both regimes, with the largest gains appearing on the more challenging ViDoRe 3 split.
blocks.zh:
多跳查询在ViDore和SlidVQA上难度较大,全管NDCG@10分别从62.4162.41降至49.6749.67和95.599559降至93.3793.37.
ViDoSeek是一个例外:它的多跳子集在所有阶段的分数都高于它的单跳子集,说明查询难度依赖于数据集,而不是仅仅通过跳计来决定.
总的来说,两个制度之间的级联依然有效,最大的收益出现在更具挑战性的ViDoRe 3拆分上。

blocks.en: We test how retrieval changes when the same query is reworded, keeping gold pages, corpus and hyperparameters identical to the main experiments. For REAL-MM-RAG, we use the released level-3 rephrasings of all 4,099 evaluation queries. For ViDoRe 3, ViDoSeek and SlideVQA, which release no rephrasings, we select the queries whose wording overlaps most with the gold page’s text, excluding names, numbers and titles (100 queries per ViDoRe 3 subset, 300 each for ViDoSeek and SlideVQA). This text-only criterion is fixed before rephrasing. GPT-5.2 rephrases each query with REAL-MM-RAG’s level-3 prompt. We keep a rephrasing only if it preserves all numbers and identifiers and a GPT-5.2 as a verifier judges it equivalent, non-leaking and meaningfully reworded (Figure 11 ); we resample a failed rephrasing up to three times. This leaves 792, 296 and 293 queries, whose rephrasings remove 22-34% of the query words that match the gold page (35% for REAL-MM-RAG). Each method is run on both the original and the rephrased version of every query, and we test whether the drop in NDCG@10 differs between methods.
blocks.zh: 我们测试当相同的查询被重新填词时检索是如何变化的,保持金页,实体和超参数与主实验完全相同. 对于REAL-MM-RAG,我们使用所有4,099个评价查询的发布的三级重写. 对于ViDoRe 3, ViDoseek 和 SlidVQA ,没有发布重写,我们选择其措辞与金页文本最重叠的查询,不包括名称,数字和标题(ViDore 3子集100个查询,ViDoseek和SlidVQA各300个查询). 此文本标准在重写前是固定的 。 GPT-5.2 使用 REAL- MM-RAG 的 level-3 提示重写每个查询 。 我们只保留所有数字和识别符,而GPT-5.2作为核查者判断它是否等同、不漏和有意义的重写,才保留重写(图11);我们重写一次失败重写最多三次。 这留下792,296和293个查询,其重写删除了22-34%的匹配金页的查询单词(35%为REAL-MM-RAG). 每种方法都运行在每次查询的原始版本和重写版本上,我们测试NDCG@10中的掉落是否因方法而异.

blocks.en: Paraphrase verification prompt You verify query pairs for an information-retrieval robustness benchmark. Determine whether the candidate is a meaningfully rewritten but strictly semantically equivalent version of the original. It must preserve the expected answer type, entities, numbers, dates, units, technical terms, comparisons, negations, alternatives, conjunctions, and multi-step requirements. It must not add contextual clues, resolve implicit references, disclose an answer, broaden the query, or narrow the query. Return valid JSON only: {"equivalent": true, "details_preserved": true, "answer_leakage": false, "meaningfully_rewritten": true, "reason": "brief explanation"}
